mode.description: edition_default: all manifests with edition_default[edition]=true; allowlist: only apps[] that also pass edition_default

access_mode.description: community: the self-hosted runtime does not require a commercial entitlement; managed: access to an operator-managed service or delivery channel may require an entitlement

seat_activation_required.description: Whether this delivery profile requires a native signed seat activation. Must be false for access_mode=community

include_legacy.description: When true, union legacy app_components (cloud transition only)

apps.description: Manifest ids (not app_component). Required non-empty when mode=allowlist

extra_app_components.description: Optional desktop app_component ids (legacy or non-manifest) unioned after allowlist/edition_default resolve. Must be known in legacy registry or a manifest surface. Used by fofline-connected selective surface.
